audit.auditType: independent read-only artifact inspection; no replay/rebuild/upload

findings.finding: Only output frame_id and capture_timestamp_ns are asserted. Other output identity fields are not asserted/stored. outputIdentityVerified must mean these two fields, not a full output-identity audit.

No accuracy or false-positive conclusion is supported: scan94 shares map-training input, scan64 relation to map unknown, independent pose truth/rectification/exposure clock metadata absent. Existing report limits acknowledge this.

Latency measures each synchronous ctypes atc_localize call, including ctypes overhead, excluding image decode/validation/output serialization/map load. First accepted time is sum of native calls and excludes map load; capture offset is recorded capture time rather than replay response latency.

Single continuous native run per map/query retains nearby retrieval/history, so it measures stateful sequences. No counterbalanced repeat evidence in current six runs. Device load/thermal/cache/thread state is uncontrolled. Original map has 92 keyframes/127685 ORB/1000 vocabulary versus v1 74/59096/500 and v2 91/70111/500, so its latency comparison bundles map size/vocabulary/producer differences.

audit.runtimeUse: No observed ATC ABI/frame-buffer/map-loading misuse. Fixed tightly packed 1920x1440 Gray8, original calibration, default config, successful atc_load_map, serial calls, fresh handle per harness invocation, no legacy feeding in the six runs.

audit.auditType: independent read-only follow-up inspection; no native replay
